title: Healthy Hearty Japanese Cabbage Agedashi
description: A low-calorie, umami-rich Japanese dish from Okinawa, featuring cabbage leaves and a sweet twist, served in a hot dolsot stone bowl.
instructions: Rinse the cabbage leaves and blanch them in boiling water for 30 seconds to make them pliable.
In a large bowl, whisk together the dashi broth, mirin, and soy sauce.
Add the grated daikon to the bowl and stir to combine.
Heat the sesame oil in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the crushed candy tuile to the saucepan and stir until melted and smooth.
To assemble the agedashi, place a cabbage leaf in the bottom of a hot dolsot stone bowl.
Spoon some of the dashi broth mixture over the cabbage leaf.
Drizzle the melted candy tuile over the top of the cabbage.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of cabbage on top.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional grated daikon if desired.
